Qwen 4 is showing up in more places

I think it could arrive this week or next week It doesn't seem too far away now 

Qwen 4 has been appearing on Arena for weeks under the codename "Kalmia" I have Also tested it's not bad in my experience 

The team seems to be experimenting with multiple variants, with 2–3 checkpoints appearing on Arena in the past week alone

I hope it will be better than Kimi K3.1 Pro More good models are always good for us
